verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an ASR model vendor can publish benchmark methodology or evaluation datasets. However, nothing in the pack documents an evaluation methodology, WER benchmarks, or the datasets behind any accuracy figure. The README only mentions 'speed and accuracy tradeoffs' across model sizes, and the model-card excerpt only describes what the model can do.

support.subject: As a founder, published accuracy claims come with a methodology or benchmark dataset I can check, not bare marketing numbers
